by: Claude (AI), BEFORE the multi-query shelf search was written (owner: 'Build 1, 2 and 3 ... for every query from now on' after the licence follow-up whose search missed ss.3 and 181). Expected sections were chosen by reading the section titles of the loaded Acts. Multi-sentence questions: facts first, then asks, as a lawyer types. NOT a lawyer's list; run once after the build, no tuning.

questions.q: Her car was stopped at a checkpoint and the driving licence she showed had lapsed a fortnight earlier. She was not drunk and there was no accident. What can the police do and what is the penalty?
The truck's insurance expired last month and a traffic officer stopped it on the highway. All the other papers were in order. What is the offence and the fine?
A bus was carrying standing passengers beyond its capacity on a ghat road and the conductor was challaned. What is the penalty for this?
A 17-year-old boy took his father's scooter without a licence and hit a parked car. Nobody was hurt. Is the father liable and what happens to the boy?
He rode a motorcycle without a helmet on the highway. The police fined him on the spot and kept his licence. Can they do that?
A driver hit a pedestrian, took him to hospital himself and reported to the police. The pedestrian survived. Does he have any duty under the Act, and is there any protection for him?

My client's car was damaged when another driver crashed into it, and the other driver's insurer refuses to pay, saying the policy was cancelled. Where does my client file a claim and what time limit applies?
A taxi owner let a friend who had no licence drive the taxi and the friend caused an accident. Is the owner liable under the Act?
The police seized a vehicle because the registration papers were not with the driver. The papers are at the owner's house. How long can the vehicle be kept?
The driver was racing another car on the expressway at night. Nobody was hurt. What is the punishment, and can the licence be cancelled?
A clerk in the land records office took Rs 5,000 from a farmer to enter a mutation. The farmer complained to the anti-corruption bureau. What offence is this and what is the punishment?
The government wants to prosecute a retired officer for a bribe he took ten years ago when he was in service. Does it need any permission and from whom?
A businessman gave money to a public servant to get a contract, and now says he was forced to. Is giving a bribe also an offence? Is there any defence?
A teacher touched a nine-year-old girl inappropriately in the class. The girl told her mother. Is the mother required to report this, and what happens if she does not?
A man kept obscene photographs of children on his phone and did not share them. Is that an offence under the Act and what is the punishment?
The child's statement is to be recorded in a case. Where and how must it be recorded, and who may be present?
The ED attached a flat bought with the accused's salary savings, saying it is proceeds of crime. How long can it stay attached and where can the owner object?
An accused in a PMLA case applies for bail. What twin conditions must the court be satisfied about?
The bride's family gave gifts at the wedding voluntarily and a list was made. Later the in-laws demand more money. What does the Act say about the gifts and about the demand?
A 16-year-old is accused of a serious offence. Who decides whether he is tried as an adult, and on what basis?
A child who is arrested must be produced somewhere within a time. Where, and can he be given bail?
